items.title: Show HN: Modelflare – One OpenAI-compatible API key for many LLMs
items.desc: title: Modelflare AI API Gateway GPT, Claude & Gemini description: One OpenAIcompatible AI gateway for LLM, image, and video models. Route requests across providers, use reliable fallbacks, and track usage and cost in one place. image: https://modelflare.dev/og/modelflareog.4c45735659c1.jpg From model access to reliable delivery. More models. One place to connect. Compare models, capabilities, and prices across providers. Choose what fits each part of your product. A backup route, built into your requests. When an upstream failure allows failover, try another eligible route for the same model. Configure a primary route and ordered backups for a regular API key. One key. Your routing preference. Use the same key across models. Modelflare selects a route for the requested model from those available to your account, following your chosen strategy. Quick start API base URLs OpenAI: https://modelflare.dev/v1 Anthropic: https://modelflare.dev Gemini: https://modelflare.dev curl https://modelflare.dev/v1/chat/completions \ H "Authorization: Bearer $MODELFLARE_API_KEY" \ H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"model": "MODEL_ID", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}' [Read the docs](https://docs.modelflare.dev/) · [View pricing](/pricing) Enterprise & teams Approved enterprise accounts get a console of their own: invite your team, give each member a budget, and see every topup, request and creation in one place. Members and budgets Invite admins and members by email, and give each an unlimited, onetime or monthly budget. Keys with your prefix Enterprise keys start with your own short name, such as acme, and every request is attributed to the member who made it. Topups and alerts The owner and admins can top up. Alerts email you before the balance or a budget runs out. Usage, creations and audit See spending by member, model and key, keep the images and videos members create, and review every admin action. [Explore enterprise plans](/enterprise) Common questions What can I do with Modelflare? Build with text, image, video, and audio models from different providers. One API and one console keep your keys, usage, and billing together. [Explore models](/pricing) How is Modelflare different from calling each provider directly? You use one API key, one base URL, and one balance for models from many providers. Each model lists its price next to the official rate, and every request records its token usage and cost. [Compare models](/pricing) Is it easy to connect my existing app? Usually you only change the base URL and API key. Use https://modelflare.dev/v1 with OpenAI SDKs and compatible tools, or https://modelflare.dev with Anthropic and Gemini SDKs. The docs cover each model and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. [Read the docs](https://docs.modelflare.dev/) How do I find the right model? Start with what you want to make. On Models & Pricing, compare capabilities, supported APIs, and rates, then open a model for the details. [Compare models](/pricing) How are prices calculated? Each model lists its price for every routing group, in units such as 1M tokens, one image, or one second of video, beside the official rate. Your console records the usage and cost of each request. [View pricing](/pricing) Do I need a subscription to start? You can start with payasyougo credits. If you prefer a plan, compare its included quota, supported models, and limits first. Your console shows usage and charges as you go. [View pricing](/pricing) What happens when an upstream provider fails? When an upstream failure allows failover, try another eligible route for the same model. Configure a primary route and ordered backups for a regular API key. [Read the docs](https://docs.modelflare.dev/) Can I keep each project under control? Give each project its own API key. Set a quota and expiration date, add model or IP restrictions when needed, and track usage separately. [Manage API keys](/signin) Can my team share one account? Yes. With an enterprise account, the whole team spends one shared balance. Invite members by email, give each a budget and their own keys, and see each member’s usage, requests and creations in the enterprise console. The owner and admins can top up, and alerts tell you before the balance or a budget runs out. [Explore enterprise plans](/enterprise) How does Modelflare handle my request data? The Trust Center explains which request data is processed, how long records are kept, which service providers are involved, and how to report a security issue. [Trust Center](/trust) Can I create without writing code? Of course. In Castaly, choose an image or video model and describe your idea. Sign in with your Modelflare account; your balance and usage records are shared. items.author: folkbench
items.descZh: Modelflare 是一款 OpenAI 兼容的 AI API 网关，旨在简化多模型 AI 服务的集成复杂性，支持 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流文本、图像和视频模型。其核心功能包括提供统一的 API 密钥和基础 URL，实现请求在不同提供商间的无缝路由，并内置可靠的故障转移机制，当上游失败时自动切换到备份路由。亮点在于用户可跨模型比较能力、价格和性能，选择最适合的方案；企业版还支持团队邀请、预算分配和详细使用审计，确保成本透明可控。适用场景涵盖需要快速集成多 AI 模型的应用开发、企业级项目管理以及成本优化团队。
items.quote: 您只需使用一个 API 密钥、一个基础 URL 和一个余额，即可使用来自多个提供商的模型。

items.desc: description: Borderdraw is coming soon to Crux, free on iPhone and iPad with no ads. Play it free in your browser. A map shows a country with its coast and its neighbours. Its land border is missing, with a dot at each end. title: Borderdraw: draw a country’s border from memory image: https://crux.quest/og/games/borderdraw.jpg Borderdraw Draw a country’s border from memory. Unfolding the map… × [Skip to the content](main) Coming soon to Crux Borderdraw I drew Portugal from memory and the real border landed on my wobbly line. [Play in your browser](play) Get Crux [](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815674578?ppid=ffec102232224ef1b8cb03e0951a7c08) Free on iPhone and iPad. No ads. This one is on its way. How to play Borderdraw 1. Find the gap. A map shows a country with its coast and its neighbours. Its land border is missing, with a dot at each end. 2. Draw it in one line. Put a finger on a dot and draw the border to the other dot from memory. Lifting your finger is your answer. 3. Watch it land. The real border draws itself over your line and the stamp shows how close you came, out of 100. 4. Three a day. The daily is three borders, easy to hard, the same for everyone. Then the expedition goes on border after border. How it fits your day Borderdraw is coming soon to Crux. It will be free to play, with no ads, like every game in the app. You can already play it free in your browser. Who it suits It suits people who like maps, flags and learning about countries. About Crux Crux is a free iPhone and iPad app from Pizzart Pte. Ltd. with a ton of daily word, logic, number, geography, trivia, colour and arcade games, and no ads. Every game is free to play and none needs a purchase: some open after a few days of play, or sooner with coins you earn by playing. Optional Crux Plus costs $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US. items.descZh: 该扩展是为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 AI 代码审查工具，旨在帮助开发者在提交前审查未提交的更改、单个文件或选中的代码段。它支持多种主流 AI 模型，包括 OpenAI GPT、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek 以及本地模型如 Ollama，用户可使用自己的 API key 或本地模型，无需注册、登录或担心每日调用限制。审查结果会以诊断信息的形式直接显示在编辑器波浪线、 Problems 面板和源代码控制树状图中，便于开发者快速定位 bug、安全漏洞、性能问题和风格缺陷。亮点在于其高度灵活性和隐私保护：代码仅发送至用户指定的提供商，无后台索引和遥测，且支持自定义审查配置文件、输出语言及大文件分块处理。Pro 版本额外提供分支审查、一键应用 AI 修复、团队规则文件及 Markdown 导出等功能，适用于个人开发者和团队在不同规模项目中的代码质量把控。

Readiness MCP — Lite An opensource [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that checks whether a public website can be read and cited by AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude) as well as classic search. Ask your assistant _"Is example.com ready for AI search?"_ and it runs five deterministic checks and returns a prioritized fix list (FAIL before WARN). No API keys, no account, no external dependencies. Option 1: ZeroInstall Remote MCP (1Click Paste — No Python or Docker Needed) Connect directly to the hosted Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with zero local setup: https://mcp.usethelever.com/geoaudit/mcp Claude Web (claude.ai) & Claude Desktop: Go to Settings → Connectors → Add Custom Connector and paste https://mcp.usethelever.com/geoaudit/mcp. ChatGPT Developer Mode (MCP): Go to Settings → Connectors → Create and paste https://mcp.usethelever.com/geoaudit/mcp. Tools Tool What it checks quick\_readiness\_report Runs every check below and returns a fix\_first list (FAIL before WARN). check\_ai\_crawler\_access robots.txt rules for the page path, split into AI search crawlers (OAISearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeSearchBot), AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, GoogleExtended, CCBot), and Googlebot/Bingbot. Blocking training crawlers is reported as a policy choice, not an error. check\_llms\_txt Whether /llms.txt exists, is Markdown rather than an HTML soft404, and has a title, sections, and links. extract\_structured\_data JSONLD types (including @graph), invalid JSONLD, canonical and og:url pointing to another host, missing meta

items.descZh: alicexixi85/geoseomcppro 是一款基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的开源 GEO 与 SEO 准备就绪探针，旨在评估网站在 AI 搜索引擎（如 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude）及传统搜索引擎中的可读性与可引用性。其核心功能涵盖 AI 爬虫访问权限检测（区分搜索、训练及传统爬虫）、llms.txt 规范校验、结构化数据（JSON-LD）提取，以及生成按“错误优先于警告”排序的优先修复清单。该工具完全开源且零依赖，无需 API 密钥或账户，提供远程 MCP 一键粘贴接入、本地 Python 命令行（可在约10秒内完成单次快速检测）及 Docker 部署等多种轻量化运行方式。适用于网站开发者、SEO 优化人员及 AI 营销团队，用于快速诊断网站在生成式 AI 搜索环境下的可见性瓶颈，并提供具体的优化指引。

[](https://telegram.org) Note 🔄 100% CrossCompatible Protocol: This Go implementation and our [Python Version](https://github.com/zenkdom/reversesockspython) share the exact same binary multiplexing protocol. Any Go reverse agent (socksreverse) can connect to a Python control server, and any Python reverse agent can connect to a Go control server seamlessly. Highperformance reverse proxy cluster engineered in Go: Universal MultiProtocol Listener (Port 1080): SOCKS5 with full TCP & UDP support: CONNECT (0x01), BIND (0x02), and UDP ASSOCIATE (0x03) per RFC 1928 / RFC 1929\. Full compatibility with Telegram VoIP calls, WebRTC, DNS, gaming, and QUIC/HTTP3. SOCKS4 & SOCKS4a: support for legacy clients and remote domain resolution. HTTP & HTTPS (CONNECT) Proxy: tunneling for HTTPS traffic and direct forwardproxying with Basic authentication. Automatic onthefly protocol detection on a single port. MTProto FakeTLS 1.3 Engine (Port 8443): Circumvents DPI/firewall filtering by masquerading as TLS 1.3 to legitimate domains (google.com). Active probe defense: scanner probes are forwarded to genuine Google endpoints returning authentic certificates. Support for Obfuscated2 (Hex32) and Promo TAGs from @MTProxybot. Builtin Web Administration UI (Port 9001): Manage SOCKS5 and MTProto credentials with realtime node health monitoring. 1click tg://proxy connect links and clipboard export. Outbound Reverse Node Pool (socksreverse): Exit nodes connect back through NAT, CGNAT, and firewalls to register with the control server. Independent roundrobin rotation per user and automatic 2second failover. MultiTor Cluster Module (reversemultitor): Run 10 isolated exit nodes with guaranteed distinct external IPs via Tor IsolateSOCKSAuth. ⚡ Why Go for HighSpeed Networking? 1. HardwareAccelerated AESNI Encryption: The Go standard library crypto/aes executes hardware AESNI CPU instructions directly in assembly, yielding multigigabit throughput with negligible CPU utilization. 2. ZeroAllocation Buffer Pools (sync.Pool): Preallocated 32 KB network buffers eliminate heap allocations in data relay loops, preventing Garbage Collector latency spikes under heavy traffic. 3. Native Epoll / IOCP Runtime Pollers: Lightweight goroutines consume mere kilobytes of memory per connection, allowing hundreds of thousands of concurrent TCP/UDP streams on modest VPS hardware. 4. Optimized Socket Options: Algorithms like Nagle are disabled (SetNoDelay(true)) to minimize latency and packet jitter. 5. Single SelfContained Binaries: No runtime, Python interpreters, or external packages required. Compiles to standalone static binaries for Linux, Windows, and macOS. 🏗 Architecture ++ WEB ADMINISTRATOR http://CONTROL_IP:9001 D
